about_the_game:
Into the Radius - Supporter Pack is a collection of game-related digital goodies for Explorers who want to go another extra mile to support the Into the Radius team.

The Supporter Pack includes the following items:


  • Camouflage patterns for PM, AKS-74U, IZh-81, OTs-33, and Mosin-Nagant*
  • Set of digital postcards
  • Set of posters ready for printing
  • Set of wallpapers
  • Original Game Soundtrack
  • Coauctor - Into the Radius Songs (Music from Cassettes)

*Please note that in order to apply camouflage patterns, you must have the appropriate firearms, which are available based on your Security Level.

Thanks for your love and support!
See you in the Radius.
